summary: Retain web runtime for HTMLFormElement.submit because it invokes the form-submission/navigation pipeline while bypassing validation and submit events.

target.notes: Runtime must execute the HTML form submission algorithm, including entry construction, target/navigation/network behavior, while preserving submit()'s bypass semantics.

caveats: A native HTTP POST is not equivalent: target browsing context, encodings, form-associated controls, CSP/sandboxing, and navigation are observable.

tests.name: submit bypasses submit event
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); let n=0; f.addEventListener('submit',()=>n++); /* f.submit() invokes submission without firing submit */
tests.expected_behavior: submit event count remains 0 before navigation side effects

tests.name: submit bypasses validation
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.required=true; f.append(i); /* f.submit() does not run interactive constraint validation */
tests.expected_behavior: submission algorithm is entered despite invalid required control
